observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher demonstrates footwork and hand movements clearly with students in the background. She breaks down movements step by step and combines them progressively.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces footwork practice with students
Practicing hand movements of the chaal
Correcting student posture and energy for turns

metaphors: It's almost like you have in ballet, you pull your partner towards you
common_mistakes: Incorrect energy and pull during turns
safety: Hold your core because your core is responsible to bring the balance in

steps_taught.name: Hand movements chaal
steps_taught.description: Arm and hand placement coordinated with chaal

what_hinders: Fast transitions between variations without much pause

quotes.text: Let's do the footwork once again so that there is more clarity.
Only the hands of the chaal.
You pull your partner towards you, that's the energy with which you should be coming back.

Teacher demonstrating upper body and hand movements facing front

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down chaal patterns into isolated footwork and hand movements before layering them together with music and posture corrections.
